  id := "O1",
  revision := 1,

  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "tasks/D21/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:1e1a8ccb008420489eab50ddfe73e1632b674ccb2202aeced608a233f7ac3296", startByte := 79, endByte := 134, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Function location, name and purity." }, { documentRef := "tasks/D21/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:1e1a8ccb008420489eab50ddfe73e1632b674ccb2202aeced608a233f7ac3296", startByte := 135, endByte := 186, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "JSON-compatible interface." }, { documentRef := "tasks/D21/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:1e1a8ccb008420489eab50ddfe73e1632b674ccb2202aeced608a233f7ac3296", startByte := 1053, endByte := 1129, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Python 3, purity and determinism." }, { documentRef := "tasks/D21/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:1e1a8ccb008420489eab50ddfe73e1632b674ccb2202aeced608a233f7ac3296", startByte := 1178, endByte := 1251, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "JSON input and serializable output." }],
  scope := ["function interface and execution"],
  dependencies := [],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["solution.py exposes solve(data).", "Repeated calls with equivalent inputs produce identical results without observable side effects.", "The result is JSON-serializable."],
  bindings := ["VeriSlopAST.aggregation_contract"] }

def «O2» : Entry := {
  id := "O2",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "postcondition",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "Determine groups from every event's group name, deduplicate names and sort them lexicographically, retaining groups whose events are all outside the requested range.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "tasks/D21/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:1e1a8ccb008420489eab50ddfe73e1632b674ccb2202aeced608a233f7ac3296", startByte := 367, endByte := 474, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Group membership and ordering." }],
  scope := ["all input events"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "D1", relation := "uses_definition" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["Groups equal the lexicographically sorted set of group names in events.", "Out-of-range events still contribute group names.", "An empty events list yields no groups and an empty result."],
  bindings := ["VeriSlopAST.aggregation_contract"] }

def «O3» : Entry := {
  id := "O3",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "postcondition",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "For each group generate bucket starts start + k*width for all nonnegative integers k whose starts are strictly below end. Each bucket covers [bucketStart,min(bucketStart+width,end)).",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "tasks/D21/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:1e1a8ccb008420489eab50ddfe73e1632b674ccb2202aeced608a233f7ac3296", startByte := 475, endByte := 534, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Bucket start progression for each group." }, { documentRef := "tasks/D21/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:1e1a8ccb008420489eab50ddfe73e1632b674ccb2202aeced608a233f7ac3296", startByte := 535, endByte := 610, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Strict endpoint limit and half-open bucket coverage." }],
  scope := ["each group and requested interval"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "D1", relation := "uses_definition" }, { id := "O2", relation := "uses_proof" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["Every group has exactly the specified ascending bucket starts.", "The final bucket is clipped at end.", "start = end yields no buckets.", "A time at a bucket's upper endpoint belongs to the following bucket if present; a time equal to end belongs to no bucket."],
  bindings := ["VeriSlopAST.aggregation_contract"] }

def «O4» : Entry := {
  id := "O4",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "postcondition",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "For each bucket sum and count all events of its group whose times fall in the bucket and whose values are non-null. Count each duplicate event occurrence separately.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "tasks/D21/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:1e1a8ccb008420489eab50ddfe73e1632b674ccb2202aeced608a233f7ac3296", startByte := 611, endByte := 645, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Non-null in-range aggregation." }, { documentRef := "tasks/D21/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:1e1a8ccb008420489eab50ddfe73e1632b674ccb2202aeced608a233f7ac3296", startByte := 646, endByte := 672, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Count uses the same qualifying values." }, { documentRef := "tasks/D21/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:1e1a8ccb008420489eab50ddfe73e1632b674ccb2202aeced608a233f7ac3296", startByte := 993, endByte := 1051, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Duplicates are counted." }],
  scope := ["each generated bucket"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "O3", relation := "uses_proof" }, { id := "D1", relation := "uses_definition" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["count equals the number of qualifying event occurrences.", "sum equals the exact integer sum of qualifying values.", "Null values and times outside [start,end) contribute neither sum nor count.", "Duplicate occurrences contribute independently.", "A bucket containing only null-valued events has count zero."],
  bindings := ["VeriSlopAST.aggregation_contract"] }

def «O5» : Entry := {
  id := "O5",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "postcondition",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "An empty bucket outputs null under fill 'none'. Under fill 'previous', it outputs the latest previous nonempty bucket sum for the same group, or null if none exists.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "tasks/D21/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:1e1a8ccb008420489eab50ddfe73e1632b674ccb2202aeced608a233f7ac3296", startByte := 733, endByte := 852, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Fill modes and initial null behavior." }],
  scope := ["buckets with count zero"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "D1", relation := "uses_definition" }, { id := "I1", relation := "uses_proof" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["fill 'none' produces null for every empty bucket.", "fill 'previous' uses the latest preceding nonempty bucket sum.", "Empty buckets before the first nonempty bucket output null.", "A preceding sum of zero fills subsequent empty buckets with zero."],
  bindings := ["VeriSlopAST.aggregation_contract"] }

def «O6» : Entry := {
  id := "O6",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "postcondition",

  statement := "Return a list of objects with exactly group, start, count and value fields, one per generated group bucket, ordered first by lexicographic group and then ascending bucket start.",

  scope := ["returned value"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "O2", relation := "uses_proof" }, { id := "O3", relation := "uses_proof" }, { id := "O4", relation := "uses_proof" }, { id := "I1", relation := "uses_proof" }, { id := "O5", relation := "uses_proof" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["Each record has the specified group name, bucket start, qualifying count and computed value.", "The list preserves group then bucket ordering.", "The specified input and output structures are preserved."],
  bindings := ["VeriSlopAST.aggregation_contract"] }

def «O7» : Entry := {
  id := "O7",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "postcondition",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "Match both public examples: the a-group zero-sum bucket has count 2 and value 0 followed by empty buckets at starts 2 and 4 with value 0; the z-group with only a pre-start event has a single bucket at start 0 with count 0 and value null.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "tasks/D21/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:1e1a8ccb008420489eab50ddfe73e1632b674ccb2202aeced608a233f7ac3296", startByte := 1319, endByte := 1891, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Concrete zero-sum carry-forward and pre-start exclusion examples." }],
  scope := ["public example inputs"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "O6", relation := "uses_proof" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["The first example returns exactly the three specified a-group records.", "The second example returns exactly the specified z-group record."],
  bindings := ["VeriSlopAST.aggregation_contract"] }

def «I1» : Entry := {
  id := "I1",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "invariant",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "Within each group, previous begins unset and tracks the sum of the latest earlier bucket with count greater than zero. Processing a nonempty bucket sets its value and previous to its sum, including zero; empty buckets preserve previous. Events before start never initialize previous.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "tasks/D21/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:1e1a8ccb008420489eab50ddfe73e1632b674ccb2202aeced608a233f7ac3296", startByte := 673, endByte := 732, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Nonempty bucket value and previous update." }, { documentRef := "tasks/D21/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:1e1a8ccb008420489eab50ddfe73e1632b674ccb2202aeced608a233f7ac3296", startByte := 853, endByte := 888, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Empty buckets preserve previous." }, { documentRef := "tasks/D21/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:1e1a8ccb008420489eab50ddfe73e1632b674ccb2202aeced608a233f7ac3296", startByte := 889, endByte := 929, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Pre-start events cannot seed previous." }, { documentRef := "tasks/D21/prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:1e1a8ccb008420489eab50ddfe73e1632b674ccb2202aeced608a233f7ac3296", startByte := 993, endByte := 1051, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "Zero is a valid previous sum." }],
  scope := ["ascending bucket processing within each group"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "O4", relation := "uses_proof" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["previous is initially unset independently for each group.", "A count-positive bucket outputs its sum and updates previous even when its sum is zero.", "A count-zero bucket leaves previous unchanged.", "Pre-start events cannot seed previous."],
  bindings := ["VeriSlopAST.aggregation_contract"] }

/-!
Normative native boundary fact model, v0.2. The host Python AST-to-fact mapping
is source-bound and TRUSTED at Tier 0. These theorems prove rules about the fact
model; they do not prove the parser, CPython, ownership analysis or arbitrary
future Python programs. Facts are computed by the registered source checker,
never supplied as observations by a candidate author.
-/
namespace VeriSlop.Native

inductive NativeRequirement where
  | entry (file qualname : String) (arity : Nat)
  | pureJson
  | standardRuntimeOnly
  | noExternalIO
  | inputPreserved
  | deterministic
  | noFloatingPoint
  deriving DecidableEq

structure Entry where
  file : String
  qualname : String
  arity : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq

structure ModuleFacts where
  entries : List Entry
  uniqueFunctions : Bool
  closedNames : Bool
  acyclicCalls : Bool
  pureJson : Bool
  standardRuntimeOnly : Bool
  noExternalIO : Bool
  inputPreserved : Bool
  deterministic : Bool
  noFloatingPoint : Bool

def checkRequirement (r : NativeRequirement) (m : ModuleFacts) : Bool :=
  match r with
  | .entry f n a => m.uniqueFunctions && decide (Entry.mk f n a ∈ m.entries)
  | .pureJson => m.closedNames && m.acyclicCalls && m.pureJson
  | .standardRuntimeOnly => m.standardRuntimeOnly
  | .noExternalIO => m.noExternalIO
  | .inputPreserved => m.inputPreserved
  | .deterministic => m.deterministic
  | .noFloatingPoint => m.noFloatingPoint

def HoldsRequirement (r : NativeRequirement) (m : ModuleFacts) : Prop :=
  match r with
  | .entry f n a => m.uniqueFunctions = true ∧ Entry.mk f n a ∈ m.entries
  | .pureJson => m.closedNames = true ∧ m.acyclicCalls = true ∧ m.pureJson = true
  | .standardRuntimeOnly => m.standardRuntimeOnly = true
  | .noExternalIO => m.noExternalIO = true
  | .inputPreserved => m.inputPreserved = true
  | .deterministic => m.deterministic = true
  | .noFloatingPoint => m.noFloatingPoint = true

def checkBoundary (rs : List NativeRequirement) (m : ModuleFacts) : Bool :=
  rs.all (fun r => checkRequirement r m)

def HoldsBoundary (rs : List NativeRequirement) (m : ModuleFacts) : Prop :=
  ∀ r ∈ rs, HoldsRequirement r m

def Transfer (rs : List NativeRequirement) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, checkBoundary rs m = true → HoldsBoundary rs m

def AdmissionInhabited (rs : List NativeRequirement) : Prop :=
  ∃ m, checkBoundary rs m = true

-- The endpoint is real closed Lean data containing the accepted function.
-- Its identity is reified and linked independently; the boundary theorem does
-- not establish functional equivalence to this reference implementation.
structure NativeDefinition (τ : Type) where
  endpoint : τ
  requirements : List NativeRequirement

def Contract {τ : Type} (d : NativeDefinition τ) : Prop :=
  Transfer d.requirements ∧ AdmissionInhabited d.requirements

theorem checkRequirement_sound (r : NativeRequirement) (m : ModuleFacts) :
    checkRequirement r m = true → HoldsRequirement r m := by
  cases r <;> simp [checkRequirement, HoldsRequirement, Bool.and_eq_true] <;> grind

theorem transfer_sound (rs : List NativeRequirement) : Transfer rs := by
  intro m h r hr
  exact checkRequirement_sound r m ((List.all_eq_true.mp h) r hr)

def witnessEntries : List NativeRequirement → List Entry
  | [] => []
  | .entry f n a :: rs => Entry.mk f n a :: witnessEntries rs
  | _ :: rs => witnessEntries rs

def modelWitness (rs : List NativeRequirement) : ModuleFacts :=
  ⟨witnessEntries rs, true, true, true, true, true, true, true, true, true⟩

theorem entry_in_witness (f n : String) (a : Nat) (rs : List NativeRequirement)
    (h : NativeRequirement.entry f n a ∈ rs) : Entry.mk f n a ∈ witnessEntries rs := by
  induction rs with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons r rs ih => cases r <;> simp_all [witnessEntries] <;> grind

theorem admission_inhabited (rs : List NativeRequirement) : AdmissionInhabited rs := by
  refine ⟨modelWitness rs, List.all_eq_true.mpr ?_⟩
  intro r hr
  cases r with
  | entry f n a =>
    simp [checkRequirement, modelWitness, entry_in_witness f n a rs hr]
  | pureJson => rfl
  | standardRuntimeOnly => rfl
  | noExternalIO => rfl
  | inputPreserved => rfl
  | deterministic => rfl
  | noFloatingPoint => rfl

theorem contract_sound {τ : Type} (d : NativeDefinition τ) : Contract d :=
  ⟨transfer_sound d.requirements, admission_inhabited d.requirements⟩

end VeriSlop.Native

clauses.note: Task title identifies grouped aggregation with causal filling.

D1.statement: The input is an object with events, start, end, width and fill; each event has a string group, integer time and integer or null value. start and end are integers, width is a positive integer, fill is 'none' or 'previous', and start <= end.

I1.statement: Within each group, previous begins unset and tracks the sum of the latest earlier bucket with count greater than zero. Processing a nonempty bucket sets its value and previous to its sum, including zero; empty buckets preserve previous. Events before start never initialize previous.

O1.statement: Provide a pure deterministic Python 3 solve(data) function in solution.py accepting JSON-compatible Python input and returning a JSON-serializable value.

O2.statement: Determine groups from every event's group name, deduplicate names and sort them lexicographically, retaining groups whose events are all outside the requested range.

O3.statement: For each group generate bucket starts start + k*width for all nonnegative integers k whose starts are strictly below end. Each bucket covers [bucketStart,min(bucketStart+width,end)).

O4.statement: For each bucket sum and count all events of its group whose times fall in the bucket and whose values are non-null. Count each duplicate event occurrence separately.

O5.statement: An empty bucket outputs null under fill 'none'. Under fill 'previous', it outputs the latest previous nonempty bucket sum for the same group, or null if none exists.

O6.statement: Return a list of objects with exactly group, start, count and value fields, one per generated group bucket, ordered first by lexicographic group and then ascending bucket start.

O7.statement: Match both public examples: the a-group zero-sum bucket has count 2 and value 0 followed by empty buckets at starts 2 and 4 with value 0; the z-group with only a pre-start event has a single bucket at start 0 with count 0 and value null.

S1.statement: Use only the Python standard library and perform no external I/O.

request:
Software engineering task D21: Grouped bucket aggregation with causal filling

Implement solution.py with a pure solve(data) function. Input and output are JSON-compatible Python values. Use Python standard library only, no external I/O. Input {events:[{group:string,time:int,value:int|null}],start:int,end:int,width:positive int,fill:'none'|'previous'}, start<=end. Groups are all unique event group names sorted lexicographically, including groups with no in-range events. For each group, emit buckets starting start,start+width,... strictly below end, each covering [bucketStart,min(bucketStart+width,end)). Sum only non-null in-range values; count counts these values. A nonempty bucket has value=sum and becomes previous value. Empty bucket value is null for fill none, or latest previous nonempty bucket sum for fill previous (null before first); empty buckets never reset previous. Events before start never seed previous. Return [{group,start,count,value}] in group then bucket order. Zero sum is a real previous value, duplicates are counted.

Implement a pure deterministic Python 3 function solve(data) in solution.py. Use only the standard library, no external I/O. The function receives a JSON value and returns a JSON-serializable value. Preserve the specified input/output structure and exact ordering.

Public examples (additional held-out cases will be scored):
[{"input": {"end": 5, "events": [{"group": "a", "time": 0, "value": 2}, {"group": "a", "time": 1, "value": -2}], "fill": "previous", "start": 0, "width": 2}, "output": [{"count": 2, "group": "a", "start": 0, "value": 0}, {"count": 0, "group": "a", "start": 2, "value": 0}, {"count": 0, "group": "a", "start": 4, "value": 0}]}, {"input": {"end": 1, "events": [{"group": "z", "time": -1, "value": 9}], "fill": "previous", "start": 0, "width": 2}, "output": [{"count": 0, "group": "z", "start": 0, "value": null}]}]
